# Risk Management Update

This document details several key actions required for the Risk & Compliance department:

*   Update legal risks based on recent audit findings.
*   Conduct quarterly investigations into Anti-Money Laundering (AML) detection processes.
*   Monitor regulatory changes, informed by audit recommendations.
*   Urgently review internal control mechanisms.
*   Continuously monitor legal risks as part of the 2026 strategic planning.
